question: Which of Tay Roc's battles is the greatest of his career?

stances.marcus-blaze: Tay Roc vs. Hollow Da Don is the undisputed greatest because it elevated him to 'the face of the URL,' a status no other battle achieved.
stances.tasha-raw: The battle against Hollow Da Don is Roc's greatest due to its historic impact and the iconic 'Seatbelt' bar, which cemented his legacy.
stances.king-knowledge: While Roc has many great battles, his performance against Hollow Da Don is the greatest overall due to its combination of historic haymakers and career-defining status elevation.

withheld.instruction: Tay Roc's second round in his battle against Ill Will is widely considered one of the greatest single rounds in the history of the Ultimate Rap League.

protected_facts.note: Tay Roc's real name is Donte Richardson.
banned_phrasings: Donte Richardson's real name is Tay Roc

waypoints.note: Marcus, you say 'the face of the URL,' but wasn't that more about a body of work than one single battle?
Tasha, you're focusing on one bar, but didn't Roc have other battles with equally iconic moments?
King Knowledge, you mention career-defining status, but how does that compare to the tangible impact of being 'the face'?
Marcus, is 'the face of the URL' truly a higher achievement than a battle that's considered one of the greatest rounds in history?
Tasha, you're fixated on the 'Seatbelt' bar, but Roc's performance against DNA had an equally iconic rebuttal.

detonation_react.instruction: Wait, Ill Will? I thought we were talking about Hollow Da Don. But that Ill Will round is definitely legendary, I'll give you that.

kk_drop.instruction: Take the floor for your ONE weight-drop: name the thing the others have been circling without seeing. Two or three sentences, NEW words only, unhurried, air around it. End by reframing the question itself.

opener.instruction: Tay Roc's battle against Hollow Da Don is the one that made him 'the face of the URL.'

exit.instruction: We can debate rounds and rebuttals all day, but the impact of Hollow Da Don cemented Roc's place. We'll be back to discuss who's next.
